title: The institutional view: implied vs realized volatility
summary: Institutional volatility desks focus on the relationship between implied and realized volatility. Retail sellers of covered calls and cash-secured puts are short vega but often look only at implied volatility. Implied is what you get paid; realized is the risk you take. The bigger the gap, the bigger the edge in a volatility selling program.

steps.caption: Implied volatility: what a short-vega seller is paid.
Realized volatility: what the underlying actually delivers.
The bigger the gap between IV and RV, the bigger the edge in selling volatility.

takeaways: Covered calls and cash-secured puts are short vega trades.
Look at implied relative to realized volatility, not implied alone.
A larger IV minus RV gap means a better selling opportunity.
caveats: The speaker's metric behind the bio link is promotional and not verified here.
